scope: Cross-review of the 17 function-level TypeScript deletion mappings proposed by compiler-transport-audit.json. No source files, builds, CI, or hosts touched.

result.recommendation: Function-body deletions are redundant at this frozen source, subject to the strict scope caveat below. Delete only these 17 functions; retain both legacy files/targets because each still contains nonmapped tests.

test_discovery.evidence: Manifest defines [lib] path="lib.rs" and has no [[test]] entries or autotests=false; workspace manifest has no override for this package. Cargo default integration-test autodiscovery therefore creates a target for each .rs file directly under tests/. The legacy and current files are separately compiled test targets today. This was determined statically; no Cargo command was run.
test_discovery.scope_caveat: Do not delete either legacy file or its target based on these mappings: the old checker file has 13 unmapped #[test] functions and old semantic file has 4. This review establishes duplicate function contracts, not that the old integration targets have no other purpose.

shared_context.checker_imports: Both import Checker, CheckerError, CheckerIndex, Declaration, LiteralBase, MappedModifier, Narrowing, Origin, Report, TypeTree and source_digest from backend_frontend_typescript::legacy. Current checker_protocol.rs additionally imports backend_semantic::vocabulary::TypeScriptSource; this is used in the current target outside the mapped tests and in the bounded-child helper. It does not change any mapped function body resolution.

checker_constants_and_fixtures.GOLDEN: Both are include_str!("transcripts/golden.json") relative to same tests directory; SHA-256 f91967d5b2da9a37d38a570f8b31a7c8fdbef0e62559266ffe81c76975707e90
checker_constants_and_fixtures.GOLDEN_SOURCE: Both are include_bytes!("fixtures/source.ts") relative to same tests directory; SHA-256 06014986b132c9502e78f2ee3221263d29b4a417f8a3b13a9ad5959361e9288e
checker_constants_and_fixtures.adapter: Both define adapter() -> Checker { Checker::default() }, exact helper text.
checker_constants_and_fixtures.golden_source: Both decode the same GOLDEN_SOURCE bytes as UTF-8 in identical helper text.

shared_context.bounded_child: Both checker files place the four process tests in #[cfg(unix)] mod bounded_child; all four have direct #[test] and same inherited unix cfg. The module static environment mutex and script() temporary executable setup are textually equivalent. with_script differs only in qualification: legacy uses backend_semantic::vocabulary::TypeScriptSource::TypeScript while current uses imported TypeScriptSource::TypeScript. This resolves to the same enum variant and sends identical source bytes to Checker::run_with_program. Thus effective platform and helper behavior match, though helper text is not byte-identical.
shared_context.semantic_imports_and_error_enum: Legacy semantic file imports analyze_with_declaration and spells CoordinateError fully qualified in AuthorityTestError; current imports CoordinateError and omits analyze_with_declaration. The removed/imported analyzer is used by an unmapped legacy test; mapped bodies call analyze only. Fully qualified and imported CoordinateError resolve to backend_frontend_typescript::legacy::CoordinateError, same From conversion. Both AuthorityTestError enums otherwise have same variants and messages, and mapped bodies construct the same variants.
shared_context.semantic_fixtures: Mapped semantic tests embed source strings in the function bodies and have no external fixtures. Their complete fn items compare byte-for-byte.

limitations: This is a focused independent audit of the listed 17 pairs, not a full TypeScript test-suite or crate audit.
The paired current/legacy targets are both discovered by Cargo; this does not assess whether repository CI explicitly filters one target.
The recommendation is to remove only duplicate test functions. It does not approve deleting old files, changing Cargo target discovery, or deleting tests not listed.
replacement_coverage: Exact retained integration-test functions exercise the same real checker protocol, source bytes, coordinates, authority refusals and bounded child lifecycle; no sole behaviour coverage removed. Both legacy targets remain for 17 unmapped tests.
runtime_status: Fresh cab7cdf38-based candidate plus exact compatibility prerequisites; exact required fast/T1, TypeScript T2, and affected TypeScript T3 are pending. No passing or flake-rate claim.
